name: The Master's Glaive
summary: In southern Darkshore, Onu sends Alliance scouts to investigate the Master's Glaive. He fears the Twilight's Hammer cult may have reached the fallen ancient horror.

sections.title: A Disturbing Presence
sections.body: Along Darkshore, Onu sees corruption linger and wildlife driven from its homes. The naga on the coast trouble him, but signs of the Twilight's Hammer are worse. Its followers worship primal lords who ruled the world before they were overthrown in ages past.

sections.title: The Fallen Lord
sections.body: South of Onu, the Master's Glaive is a grim excavation around a colossal creature pierced by a great stone weapon. Onu gives you a Phial of Scrying and asks you to enter the pit and learn whether the cultists have gathered there. The behemoth has been dead for eons, yet corruptive power still clings to its bones. The Twilight's Hammer may seek to claim it.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
aliases: who gives the masters glaive quest
faq.answer: Onu, an ancient of lore, sends you from his place along the road in southern Darkshore, near the Grove of the Ancients.

The Master's Glaive is an ancient site in southern Darkshore, where a monstrous ancient lord fell eons ago, pierced through the skull by a titanic stone glaive. Its vast petrified skeleton remains buried in the earth.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult interested in the site?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer worships the old, dark powers of ancient Azeroth. Slivers of primeval power remain in the long-dead creature's remains, and the cultists seek to harness them.

faq.q: How do I report back to Onu?
faq.answer: After exploring the excavation pit, use the Phial of Scrying from your bags to call forth a Scrying Bowl on the ground. Through it, you can speak to Onu by magic without returning to him.
Once the Scrying Bowl confirms the cultists are there, Onu sends you to their encampment in The Twilight Camp to learn more about their activities.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the Master's Glaive as a reminder of terrors older than your people. Mad cultists trespassing on Darkshore's sacred soil is an intolerable defilement.
As a druid, you answer Onu's call to learn how the ancient taint buried deep in the earth disturbs the land and its wildlife.
As an Alliance member, you help keep the Twilight's Hammer from awakening ancient horrors that could overrun northern Kalimdor's struggling settlements.
